description: Defines internal socket structures and helper functions for POSIX sockets in the starboard shared library, including SbSocketPrivate class, SockAddr class, and socket option functions.

classes.name: SockAddr
classes.description: Helper class for converting between socket address structures and SbSocketAddress.

methods.name: TranslateSocketErrno
methods.description: Translates an errno value from socket calls into an SbSocketError.

methods.name: SetBooleanSocketOption
methods.description: Sets a boolean socket option with proper checks.

methods.name: SetIntegerSocketOption
methods.description: Sets an integer socket option with proper checks.

methods.name: SockAddr::FromSockaddr
methods.description: Initializes SockAddr from a sockaddr pointer.
